name: HiveMind
notes: + Log on the Inspect tab now opens on the hive you picked in the dropdown.
In hands-free, the whole-hive questions (treat or feed, temperament, honey, mites) are asked once, after the last box.
"No queen in this box" no longer marks the hive queenless, and it waits a little longer for you to finish an answer.
Get more voices opens the phone's text-to-speech settings. More misheard words fixed.
